Name: KRE's Stardew Valley Portraits
Author: KREllll
Description:
Hi, I didn't know the day would come for me to upload mods here. I've only downloaded some mods here before..
Thanks mychocolate for recommending me to upload portraits here.
I've been posting mods to Naver Cafe. Here's link: [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/440460]https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/440460[/url]

I made some non-marriage candidates' potrtaits.
Demetrius, Fizz, George, Governor, Grandpa, Henchman, Krobus
Character files are not included except Fizz and Henchman.
(If you made character files based my portraits, please let me know. I want to use it too...🥲 and i'll also leave your file's link in my post.)

[b][size=3]How to install[/size][/b]
There are two methods of installation: xnb and CP.
[b]xnb: [/b]extract and paste the files in[ Stardew Valley/Content/Portraits or Characters ].
For the Henchman and grandpa files, you can choose between two versions, clear the numbers in file name, and paste them into the portraits folder.
[b]CP: [/b]Install SMAPI mod, and Paste the extracted folder into [ Stardew Valley/Mods ].
CP mod was made by nancyxdrewx. Thanks!
